turn: I finished the token bucket per API key by adding a test, TestBurstThenRefill, in src/bucket/bucket_test.go. It builds a bucket with a capacity of 2 and a refill rate of 1 token per second. It checks that two requests at the same instant are allowed and a third is rejected. It then checks that one second later a request is allowed again because a token has refilled. I wrote the test to match the Bucket behavior, but I haven't run it, so it hasn't passed yet. In the same commit I made one small unrelated fix: I corrected a misleading comment in the bucket package that said the refill rate was per millisecond when it is per second. Next I'll start on Key extraction from requests.

sidefix.title: Correct refill rate comment units
sidefix.what: Changed a bucket package comment that described the refill rate as per millisecond to say per second, matching the code.
